candidates.claim: If a proxy is configured (manually or via environment variables), proxy options will be set on the request alongside `socketPath`, which causes Node.js to throw an error.
candidates.evidence:
var proxy = config.proxy;
    if (!proxy && proxy !== false) {
candidates.suggested_fix: Disable or ignore proxy configurations when `config.socketPath` is defined. For example, set `proxy = false;` if `config.socketPath` is truthy before resolving the proxy configuration.
